guidance.condition: Presentation for the Alpha Idea SME Stars 2026 investor event; FY26 revenue ₹269 Cr
guidance.quote: Going forward, supported by strong demand visibility, faster execution capabilities, an improving product mix, and better operating leverage, we expect to sustain our multifold growth trajectory through FY27.
guidance.speaker: Vishal Jain (Chairman & MD), in the presentation
guidance.revises: Growth similar to the last 2-3 years (Aug 2026)

guidance.quote: We are making steady progress on our capacity expansion plans, which remain on track for commercial operations from February 2027.
guidance.speaker: Vishal Jain (Chairman & MD), in the presentation

insights.summary: Investor presentation for the Alpha Idea SME Stars event (6 September 2026), mostly a restatement of Q1 FY27: revenue ₹95 Cr, EBITDA margin 11.9%, unexecuted order book ₹142 Cr plus a ₹150 Cr pipeline. The chairman now says the company expects to 'sustain our multifold growth trajectory through FY27' and that the 60% capacity expansion remains on track for February 2027. FY26 revenue was ₹269 Cr (2.6x FY24) and PAT ₹18 Cr (24x FY24).

what_changed.text: Wording moved to 'multifold growth' through FY27
Capacity expansion on track for February 2027

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: we expect to sustain our multifold growth trajectory through FY27.

red_flags.text: Deck is mostly images with few numbers in text; no new data beyond Q1.
Growth language ('multifold') stronger than on the call a month earlier.
